second_items.entity: Material allowance corresponding to the bound 0.5
readings: A normalized material-volume fraction of 0.5, allowing 1.5 m³ in the 3 m³ box.

readings: Fix both displacement components at every node on the left edge.
Fix both displacement components only at the upper-left and lower-left corner nodes.

second_items.entity: Radius of the solidified neighborhood around the load

Use radius r=2h_c around the loaded line.

second_items.entity: Right-edge load distribution
readings: Apply a concentrated downward force at (1,0).
Apply uniform downward traction over x=1, -0.05<y<0.05.

second_items.entity: Rectangle aspect ratio
readings: Lx/Ly = 2, assuming square elements.
Lx/Ly approximately 1.75, following the displayed rectangle.

The same resultant distributed equally over the midpoint node and its two adjacent right-edge nodes.

V0 is the available volume after subtracting the two prescribed voids.

The illustrated retained state was obtained at vf = 0.28.
second_items.evidence: Table 3, problem 3; Sec. 4.4, retained compliance definition; Fig. 2 caption; Appendix A, Table 14.

readings: An external loading fixture with no fixed-solid shell voxels inside the unit-cube design domain.
One complete top voxel layer held solid, with thickness 1/40 of the cube side.
Two complete top voxel layers held solid, with thickness 2/40 of the cube side.

Enforce the prescribed fraction only on the prefilter density; allow the final fraction to follow from the filter's boundary treatment.

Divide the downward resultant equally between the two nodes of the bottom edge of the corner element.
Divide the downward resultant equally between the two nodes of the right edge of the corner element.

Fix both displacement components at the upper-left and lower-left corner nodes.

readings: Clamp only the four bottom corner nodes.

Clamp finite corner blocks extending above those patches.

readings: Impose 20.25% on the designable region, excluding passive material from both numerator and denominator.
Impose 20.25% on the entire box, counting retained passive material toward the budget.

Use 1 mm-wide passive solid end strips and fix all nodes within those strips.
